description_en: Used to verify the enterprise name and enterprise certificate number. The name and certificate must be fully consistent, and the enterprise must be in operating status for the verification to pass
description_zh: 用于核验企业名称和企业证件号，名称和证件必须全部一致且企业经营状态为在营才会判定核验通过
kebab_example: aliyun dytnsapi company-two-elements-verification --ep-cert-no 92420320000000J627 --ep-cert-name '某企业' --auth-code Dd1r0004id --api-version 2020-02-17 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CompanyTwoElementsVerification

parameters.help_en:
Authorization code.

Log on to the Cell Phone Number Service console (https://dytns.console.aliyun.com/overview?spm=a2c4g.608385.0.0.79847f8b3awqUC), and obtain the authorization ID (i.e., authorization code) on the My Applications (https://dytns.console.aliyun.com/analysis/apply) page
parameters.help_zh:
授权码。

登录号码百科控制台 (https://dytns.console.aliyun.com/overview?spm=a2c4g.608385.0.0.79847f8b3awqUC)，在我的申请 (https://dytns.console.aliyun.com/analysis/apply)页面，获取授权ID即授权码
parameters.name: auth_code

DetailInfo.description_en:
Enterprise details.

This field is not returned for public institutions or civil groups
DetailInfo.description_zh:
企业详细信息。

事业单位、民事团体不支持返回此字段

EnterpriseStatus.description_en: The operating status of the enterprise

OpenTime.description_en: The business term of the enterprise

InconsistentData.description_en: The fields that are inconsistent in the verification

items.description_en:
EpCertName: Enterprise name
EpCertNo: Enterprise certificate number
items.description_zh:
EpCertName：企业名称
EpCertNo：企业证件号

ReasonCode.description_en:
The verification result code. Valid values:

0: Verification consistent
1: Verification consistent, the enterprise is not in normal operation
3: The two enterprise elements failed verification
4: No such enterprise found
ReasonCode.description_zh:
核验结果编码。取值：

0：核验一致
1：核验一致，企业非正常营业
3：企业二要素不通过
4：查无企业

VerifyResult.description_en:
The verification result. Valid values:

true: The information is verified to be consistent, and the enterprise is operating normally.
false: The verification failed.

The operating status verification is not supported for public institutions or civil groups. Only the consistency between the enterprise name and the enterprise certificate number is verified
VerifyResult.description_zh:
核验结果。取值：

true：信息核验一致，且企业正常经营。
false：核验不通过。

事业单位、民事团体不支持核验企业经营状态，仅核验企业名称与企业证件号是否一致

Message.description_en: The description of the returned status code

RequestId.description_en: The common parameter. Each request returns a unique ID, which can be used to troubleshoot and locate issues
RequestId.description_zh: 公共参数，每个请求返回的ID都是唯一的，可用于排查和定位问题
